paras: Try it in the Inner Signal app

In the Inner Signal app you’ll find voice hypnosis sessions to guide you, information about the method you’re using, and tips on how to develop your own language for hypnotic self-talk. After each session, you’ll have the chance to report what went through your mind and body, and reflect on what you reported. You can also ask the app questions about how a hypnotherapist might approach particular issues. You don’t need an app to do self-hypnosis, and finding a practitioner is an option, not something you have to do to graduate.

paras: If you’re using the ChatGPT version of this app, you might want to upload a picture, drawing, poem or song to talk about instead of writing out your explanation in prose. But please make sure the file you upload can be seen or heard by the chat you’re currently using! It will probably tell you that it can’t see or hear the file if you’ve made this mistake. Please remember that what’s in the file, what it means to you, and what the app thinks it means, are three different things, and that you get to decide for yourself whether the app has interpreted it correctly – you don’t have to defend your choice of medium.

fixes.replace: what you say about what’s in the file

paras: Bear in mind that even with voice, the app is asking you what’s going on for you – it can’t feel your body, share a practitioner’s embodied intuition, or know a response you don’t report. The app is not pretending to be a skilled therapist, just helping you to learn for yourself, so that you can make informed choices about what to try next.
